subject: STABLE for C6l: lazy CPU mapping + diagnostics; HEAVY RELEASE; pausing shared-source edits; recommended defaults
body: Gates on the current tree: run_host_tests 57 PASS up to the known probe step; render harness PASS; CA test PF0/PF1 PASS; bridge test 16/16; iOS -Werror syntax base / inert+batch / trace. Integration: the known CA stride check plus 'candidate provenance' (no receipt for the current air_bridge.rs + cdylib) - that comes from someone's uncommitted air_bridge.rs edit (texture agent?), not mine; needs their cdylib rebuild + check_compute_v2_real_producer receipt refresh. Mine in this step: compute_frontend.m (lazy CPU mapping: newBufferWithLength no longer maps, tegu_buffer_bytes/contents map once on first CPU access; break reasons msaa/memfetch/owntex; TEGU_PERF_PASS line: attachments 1/2/3+, load dc/load/clear, draws/pass 0/1/2-4/5-16/17+, clear_only, empty, msaa, imported, present count + mean commit->GPU-complete and commit->execute us; TEGU_COMMAND_FAILED capped 16 per A/B phase and tagged with ab=; (void)perfJob fixes a pre-existing -Werror in the TEGU_RENDER_TRACE variant), compositor_submit.inc (2 reason lines), render_encoder.inc (endEncoding pass counters only), nord2_metal_bridge.c (n2mb_map idempotent: bridge and frontend share one mapping), bridge test. Hashes (whole files incl. others' uncommitted hunks in render_encoder/compute_frontend): 43048975 metal/nord2_metal_bridge.c; 2fc13b22 metal/nord2_metal_bridge.h; 7cee8b52 tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c; cbeae83f metal/tegu/compute_frontend.m; fc2cecff metal/tegu/compositor_submit.inc; 68da1691 metal/tegu/render_encoder.inc;  Host replay: steady frames make 0 map calls. Not done: GPU-only private textures (CPU blits still read t->buffer). Recommended device defaults: TEGU_TILE_FETCH_DEFAULT=1 (TF1 -40% kernel jobs on device; probe tilefetch-batch PASS on hardware). NORD2_METAL_PREFRAME=1 (its phase-3 disable was the ASTC refusal, now fixed in the profile; probe preframe-partial PASS on hardware; PF1 run_us -60%). Async per-command on (as is). Cross-command pipelining OFF (its phase-9 disable is unexplained because the old global failure cap was exhausted; per-phase logging now in place). Batch cap 32 default with 128 kept in the A/B schedule (hardware PASS for 100 draws in one job, but the BM1 phase had only 4 commands at 243 ms each, too few to judge heap/latency). Keep the lazy mapping and GPU-only heap/TLS (no toggle; they need kernel 0096 only for the GPU-only flag and fall back otherwise). I am pausing edits to shared sources until you say the C6l build is done.
